cohort: The cohort consisted of 60 pregnant women with Rh-negative blood who were attending an antenatal clinic and admitted to an obstetric unit.
finding: Despite various observed fetomaternal complications in Rh-negative pregnancies, no incidence of isoimmunisation was found in the present study.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was observed, with most cases delivering between 37-40 weeks, some after 40 weeks, and others between 30-37 weeks.
